title: Lost item at hotel (mid-level)
question:
You recently stayed at a hotel and left something valuable in your room.

Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter
• give details of your stay
• describe the item you left behind
• say what you would like the manager to do

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:
Dear Sir or Madam,
essay:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to you because I forget something in your hotel. I stay in your hotel last week from 3 to 6 May in room 214 with my wife.

When I go home I see that my watch is not in my bag. It is a silver watch with black leather strap and it was gift from my father so it is very important for me. I think I leave it on the table near the bed or maybe in bathroom.

Can you please ask your cleaning staff if they find it? If you find it please send it to my home address and I will pay for the post. You can call me on 0412 555 789 anytime.

Thanks you very much for your help. I hope to hear from you soon.

Your faithfully,
Ramesh Thapa
